text:
I am absenting myself from myself.

Little by little, the ballast of dream gives way

to the double reality

that is my life in passage.

Another being inside my flesh

forges its flesh, its skin,

its tiny heart, my star!


I attend the silent splitting

with yearning astonishment, with the new

joy of seeing myself in other eyes of mine,

made from my eyes,

colored by my blood,

ah, by all that I am.


Day by day the heartbeat

is a blow that reminds me, urgent,

of courage I do not have,

of heroism I never dreamed.


And I fear for the one I am creating

in agreed mystery

inside my shoreless solitude,

near my heart, its star.

translation.title: I Am Absenting Myself from Myself
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the pregnancy/self-division image and the child as star near the heart.
